title: Correct immutable completion actuals through an append-only hash chain

outcomes.statement: A completed work item can correct a factual actuals error without editing its original readiness actuals or terminal evidence.
outcomes.demo: Append a correction targeting the SHA-256 of the currently effective actuals and prove the original readiness and terminal bytes remain unchanged.

outcomes.statement: Readiness validation, Nous timeline reconciliation, and execution-budget recalibration resolve the same latest valid correction chain.
outcomes.demo: Load one corrected item through the tenant validator and Nous timeline/calibration paths and observe identical effective actuals plus visible provenance.

outcomes.statement: CHG-058 retains its original mistaken measurement as audit history while its effective changed-file count is corrected from 11 to 8 and its start boundary is described accurately.
outcomes.demo: Show the raw CHG-058 actuals, the appended correction, and effective actuals with changed_files 8, total 125, variance -175, and no replacement mutation campaign.

uncertainties.statement: Whether an append-only correction can preserve immutable raw actuals while every consumer resolves one unambiguous effective value.
uncertainties.resolution: Use an actuals_corrected feedback event whose target SHA-256 must equal the currently effective complete actuals. Each event carries a full replacement actuals object, unique ref, correcting CHG, reason, evidence, and timestamp; consumers fold the validated chain in ledger order while retaining the raw readiness object.

uncertainties.statement: Whether the tenant can introduce the event without diverging from Nous-owned vocabulary and recalibration semantics.
uncertainties.resolution: Nous owns the canonical event schema, ingestion, vocabulary emission, timeline reconciliation, and calibration projection. The tenant adopts the delivered vocabulary and implements the matching readiness projection; no tenant hand-edit of generated guidance is allowed.

actuals.root_cause: Closed measurement cutoff is the independently reviewed source d01486796490b62c0b50d1a35bdc979ae86ce1ff followed only by evidence. The non-overlapping UTC intervals are readiness round(1201s/60)=20 from the approval/start boundary 2026-09-08T15:12:35Z to the plan authority boundary 2026-09-08T15:32:36Z; implementation round(30888s/60)=515 through the first complete tenant implementation 561e2cb55027f277c19928fc420878d6670edccd at 2026-09-09T00:07:24Z, including the awaited canonical substrate delivery and its tenant adoption; review round(3072s/60)=51 through d014867 at 2026-09-09T00:58:36Z; and integration round(1554s/60)=26 through the corrected Nous round-trip at 2026-09-09T01:24:30Z. Focused verification is zero because it was interleaved with implementation and review without an independent boundary. Reproduce changed_files=15 with git diff --name-only -z authority/chg-059-base..d014867 | tr -cd '\0' | wc -c and commits=7 with git rev-list --count authority/chg-059-base..d014867. Four review-to-fix cycles covered canonical resolver alignment, timestamp precision/delivery adoption, adversarial trust/ref/immutability gaps, and retained-campaign consistency. Two cache-cleared attempts consumed 779.1s and 0.53s, rounded from their 779.63s sum to 13 mutation minutes: the first omitted the approved base and is retained as one mutation_invalidation after selecting 21 unrelated historical shards; the replacement used MUTATION_WORK_ID=CHG-059 and MUTATION_BASE=authority/chg-059-base, reported 16 changed paths but zero mutatable TypeScript ranges and zero shards, and exited 0. Total is 20+515+0+51+26=612 and variance is 612-300=312.
